title: Authored Cantonese daily long-phrase development review

provenance.author: Codex (AI-authored project fixture; no native-speaker approval claimed)
provenance.construction: Ten daily-life topic groups, each with three short, three medium and three long phrases. Targets and intended numeric readings frozen before lexical support checks. One reported phrase and three short controls are explicitly separate.
provenance.review_status: All 93 text/readings independently reviewed by a second project agent before ranking; spelling independently checked against the frozen factual grid. No human/native-speaker or audio approval claimed.
provenance.limits: Project-authored development cases are neither sampled human keystrokes nor a representative Cantonese test set. Tone-free collisions, alternate natural pronunciations and output orthography require separate interpretation; exact gold text remains fixed.

pre_ranking_reading_corrections.reason: Pre-ranking contextual pronunciation review: 開會 meeting uses hoi1 wui2; both pinned Rime and Words.hk exact word sources agree. No target text or primary Yale letters changed.

pre_ranking_reading_corrections.reason: Pre-ranking contextual pronunciation review: 開會 meeting uses hoi1 wui2; both pinned Rime and Words.hk exact word sources agree. No target text or primary Yale letters changed.

contextual_reading_review_sources.sense: Light verb/aspectual use, not the surprise interjection

input_policy: Primary input is compact plain Yale without tone marks or low-register h. user_input, when present, replaces only 唔/m4 with user-habit ng at syllable boundaries and is scored as a separate input group.

lexical_validation.method: Read-only exact text/reading existence queries; no candidate engine search or use of weights/ranks. Whole-text presence is measured after authoring and did not select targets.
lexical_validation.mapping_checks: Every used syllable agrees across the production spelling-only converter, independently composed onset/final chart grid and stored syllable Yale field, and has a stored spelling alias row. Alias provenance may retain an earlier cheaper heuristic after deduplication.
